events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: What happened? We've updated the demo, once more, a lot of things are happening in the backend of the game, and a lot of prep work has been put into the main world and the main game's systems. Additions : New kicking system. You can now kick enemies (with the default key F). They will try to get back up.Down finisher. events.title: Our Demo is OUT!
events.summary: We have been showcased on the mighty IGN! We would like to thank everyone for the kind words all over social media! Our project has come a long ways since its inception, a simple idea about a monster hunter in the medieval times of our dear Transylvania. We're proud to release our Demo, and we plan to keep moving forward with more monsters, epic weapons, stories and folk music!

events.title: Short combat showcase
events.summary: Everything's been improved since older showcases, from the A.I. of the enemies, to the visuals and the feel of the swordplay. There is a lot left to be done, but we are on the right track! See you on the next showcase and thank you for following us!
